relations.subject: BOYLE, John Archibald
relations.evidence: British Civil Servant in South India . Son of Rev. Edward Fitzmaurice Boyle, vicar of Hammersmith. Educated at Radley College (Oxfordshire), until 1858. From 1865 in Madras Civil Service.
